description: The real moat. Not 15 documents. A system that turns buyer interest into external evidence into package upgrades.

the_loop.action: CEO sends buyer outreach package (R352) to ideal buyer
Buyer reviews one-page summary + executive email
If interested, buyer requests NDA → full dossier
Buyer's technical team reviews full dossier
Buyer decides: commission validation, co-develop, or pass
If buyer funds experiment: external party executes

the_loop.machine_role: Ingest through R341 pipeline (16 admissibility checks + IV content cross-check)

the_loop.action: If admissibility passes: candidate transitions to REAL_LOOP_VERIFIED / T2-CONDITIONAL
Machine updates posterior using Bayes rule with external observation
the_loop.artifact: Updated posterior (replaces T1 prior with reality-informed value)

the_loop.action: Machine recomputes EIG, selects next experiment, regenerates package
CEO returns to buyer with upgraded evidence package
the_loop.artifact: Updated buyer meeting pack with T2 evidence

the_insight: The machine does NOT replace the CEO in buyer relationships. It makes the CEO dramatically more effective by: (1) producing buyer-ready packages, (2) processing reality when data returns, (3) upgrading evidence automatically, (4) regenerating packages with stronger evidence. The CEO owns the relationship. The machine owns the learning.
